s: Din hacholeb behema beyom tob ubo ch' seipim: kebar nitbaer besimman ttz"h sheasur lachalob behema beyom tob, apillu rotzeh leekol hechalab bo bayyom. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshecholeb letok keli reqan o letok keli sheyyesh bo mashqin, abal muttar lachalob letok keli sheyyesh bo maakal, lepi shemmashqeh habba laokel — hare hu kaokel, venimtza sheen al hechalab torat mashqeh ella torat okel, vahare zeh kemaprid okel meokel bachalibato, veen zeh mepareq, kevan sheeno oseh kederek periqato, shehu hapradat hechalab shehu mashqeh miggup habbehema shehu okel.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshecholeb letok hammaakal kede letaqqeno al yede chalab zeh, o sheyyesh bakkeli perurin vehechalab nibla bahem umitareb immahem yapeh, sheaz hu batel legabbe haokel vetorat okel alayv, abal hacholeb chalab harbeh letok keli sheyyesh bo meat lechem, ap al pi shemmeat chalab nibla ballechem, kevan sheharbeh chalab nishar lebaddo bakkeli sheeno meorab im haokel — hare torat mashqeh alayv, veasur mishshum mepareq.

Vaapillu choleb letok hammaakal letaqqeno — en hetter ella bibhema haomedet laakila, dehaynu shello hiqtzuha lachalabah, ella dato leshochotah, veim haya rotzeh haya shochatah veokelah beyom tob im hechalab shebbetokah, venimtza sheen al hechalab torat nolad, kevan sheap keshehaya begup habbehema haya yakol leoklo beyom tob, veeno ella kemaprid okel meokel hammechubbar lo, sheen al shum echad mishshenehem torat nolad. Abal behema shehiqtzuha lachalabah, kevan sheen dato leshochotah — en aleha torat okel kelal apillu lehammattirin muqtzeh beyom tob, shehare en dato leoklah, venimtza shehechalab hammuprad mimmenna yesh alayv torat nolad, shehare keshehaya begup habbehema lo haya okelo beyom tob, ulepikak ap al pi shecholebo letok hammaakal veyesh torat okel alayv, mikkol maqom asur leoklo beyom tob mishshum nolad leminhagenu sheanu machmirim benolad beyom tob, veasur lachalob shello letzorek yom tob.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bebehemat yisrael, abal muttar lachalob behemat hannokri letok hammaakal ap al pi shehi muqtzet lachalabah, deen muqtzeh shayyak beshel nokri kemo shennitbaer besimman ttz"ch, vahare zo keillu hayeta omedet laakila, shemmuttar lachalob mimmenna letok hammaakal.

Vekol zeh lekattechilla, abal bediabad shekkebar nechlab letok keli reqan vehi omedet laakila — hare chalab zeh muttar baakila bo bayyom apillu lehacholeb atzmo. Veen tzarik lomar sheim chalabah hannokri apillu middaat hayyisrael shehu muttar, lepi sheen torat nolad al chalab zeh, kevan shehabbehema omedet laakila, veillu haya hayyisrael rotzeh haya cholebah beatzmo behetter, dehaynu letok hammaakal, venimtza shechalab zeh hu mukan meereb yom tob, shehare beyado hu lachalob et behemto bekol et sheyyirtzeh. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim daapillu hi behemat hannokri, vaapillu chalabah hannokri letzorko veyisrael raahu (deim lo ken belav haki asur mishshum chaleb hannokri, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman qt"v) — hare chalab zeh asur bo bayyom, lepi shekkeshehaya chalab zeh begup habbehema haya alayv torat okel, mippene shehu tapel legabbe habbehema venechshab okel kemotah, veakshav shennechlab letok keli reqan — hare torat mashqeh alayv, vahare zeh domeh lemashqin shezzabu mehaokalin sheasurin bo bayyom, mishshum gezera shemma yischot, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"k ayyen sham. Uleinyan halaka, kebar nahagu kisbara haacharona, veen leshannot.

Vekol zeh bibhema haomedet laakila, o shehi shel nokri, abal im hi omedet lachalabah vehi shel yisrael, apillu chalabah nokri letok hammaakal letzorko shello middaat hayyisrael veraahu yisrael acher — hare zeh asur mishshum nolad ap lisbara harishona, shehare ap im hayyisrael haya rotzeh lo haya muttar lo lecholbah apillu letok hammaakal, kevan shehi omedet lechalab.

Vekol zeh bechalab shennechlab beyom tob atzmo, abal im nechlab beshabbat shellepanayv, apillu hayeta habbehema omedet laakila — hare zo keillu hayeta omedet lachalabah, kevan sheeno yakol leshochotah bo bayyom, ulepikak apillu chalabah nokri letzorko shello middaat hayyisrael veraahu yisrael acher — hare chalab zeh asur beshabbat (mishshum nolad apillu chalabah letok hammaakal), kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"h ayyen sham. Vaapillu beyom tob shelleacharayv asur, mishshum hakana, sheen shabbat mekina leyom tob kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqy"g, ayyen sham hattaam. Abal muttar leekol chalab zeh beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot shechal lihyot besheni beshabbat. Vaapillu nechlab beyom tob rishon — muttar leoklo belel yom tob sheni miyyad, veen tzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu apillu im chalabo nokri middaat yisrael letok keli reqan vehi omedet lechalab, shehare mimma napshak: im yom rishon hu qodesh — yom sheni hu chol, veen issur nolad noheg bo, veen shayyak ligzor kan: shemma yomar lehannokri lachalob beyom tob letzorek hallayla kede lemaher akilato belel sheni im nattir lo leekol hechalab belel sheni miyyad, shehare apillu lekattechilla muttar lomar lenokri: "chalob parati", apillu beshabbat, mishshum tzaar baale chayyim, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"h.

Mi shehu mitztaer mechamat reabon — muttar linaq mehabbehema beyom tob ap al pi sheasur beshabbat, lepi shemmepareq kilachar yad hu, ubimqom tzaar lo gazeru beyom tob, sheissur mepareq bo eno ella middibre soperim. Veim yesh lo maakal — asur linaq bepiv, ella yachalob letok hammaakal. Veken im yesh nokri — yachalob lo hannokri.
